_comment: DBA-registered critical queries. Fixed SQL written and reviewed by a human, never generated by the LLM. Executed only as SELECT inside a READ ONLY transaction with statement_timeout.

probes.name: Pending orders report by region
probes.name_es: Reporte de pedidos pendientes por región
probes.sql: SELECT c.region, count(*) AS order_lines, sum(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS amount FROM public.orders o JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY amount DESC
probes.slo_note: Latency objective set by the DBA team for this report (configuration, not a measurement).
